request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #189

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/189#issuecomment-6860006626, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-76ef`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026, package C10. Six chapters (only the flagged passages): `soft-curvature-receipts.tex`, `annulus-fleet-face-estimates.tex`, `annulus-two-wave-estimates.tex`, `annulus-same-data-binding.tex`, `inherited-loop-transport.tex`, `quadratic-pole-transport.tex`. New author record `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C10/source-leakage-189.md`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. The account ADB991 authored no C10 chapter (it wrote the independent C10 reviews #148, #149, #161).

Answers all nine C10 rows of the #159 source-leakage audit. The full response table is in `results/C10/source-leakage-189.md`, together with every moved caveat and its source locator.

| n | class | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 120 | J | **Resolved by a definition.** The sentence deferred the *definition* of the periodization sums and of $\widehat H(0)$ for arbitrary bed arrays to the source. The text now states the convention: the unconditional sum if the family is summable (equivalently absolutely summable), and $0$ otherwise. This matches `YM.Bloch.Row.acts` and `YM.Laurent.read` (Mathlib `tsum`). No new input. |
| 121 | B | "Orion datum" parenthesis removed; the name was already in `part-B/correspondence.md`. |
| 122 | B | Reworded to "two separate applications of the finite-volume receipts to the common family of local records", which is what the subsection above proves. |
| 123 | B | "In the source, (W) is obtained from …" becomes "The natural route to (W) is through …". The caveat that the conversion is not stated, so (W) and (S) stay inputs, is kept in the text. |
| 124 | B | Now a summary in terms of the proof's own steps and labels; the pointer to the "companion evidence record" is removed (moved to the record). |
| 125 | ? → B | "source normalization" becomes "this normalization"; it is defined in the preceding sentence. |
| 126–127 | B | The four unused step data stay listed. The caveat "stated under weaker hypotheses than in the source" moved to the record, item (f). |
| 128 | B | Reworded; packaging of `critical`/`wind` in `YM.Stationary.Scud` moved to the record, item (g). |

No statement, hypothesis, estimate, constant or label changed. No new named input; ledgers unchanged.

Outside the rows: `annulus-same-data-binding.tex` l.267–268 prints the source name HorizCalc$(\dots)$. The audit's patterns miss it; left unchanged and noted in the record.
